title: Chess.com Blunder Cluster by Time Control
dataSources: Steam activity and achievements (`steam:activity`), Chess.com games (`chesscom:game`), online-go matches (`ogs:game`), and poker home-game hands or settlements (`pokerhome:session`).
app: Gaming and play telemetry from Steam, Chess.com, Online-Go servers, and poker home-game logs sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and export files.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=chesscom:game
| search blunders=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(blunders) as blunders avg(accuracy_pct) as avg_accuracy_pct by _time time_control
| sort - _time
description: Tracks Chess.com blunders over time and breaks it out by time control.
value: Time-control splits are one of the cleanest ways to see whether the mistakes are really about speed pressure.
implementation: Send Chess.com blunders events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of Chess.com blunders by time control.
grandmaExplanation: It records how Chess.com blunders changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
